goals.name: PC
goals.goal: A machine that is safe to run long jobs on.

goals.name: Sync
goals.goal: Every track of an imported song plays in sync with its video, from bar 1, every time.

goals.name: Import
goals.goal: Every UG tab or PDF imports with all its parts, all its bars and the right notes.

goals.name: Songbook
goals.goal: Play from chord charts on stage and share them to other apps.

goals.name: Practice
goals.goal: A daily guitar practice that the app checks with the phone's mic.

goals.name: App
goals.goal: The newest app on the phone, with the tunings you play.

goals.name: TabMaker
goals.goal: A model that turns audio into tab, for songs with no UG tab.

goals.name: Hands-off
goals.goal: Everything runs from one command, with a plain guide, after 2026-11-04.

cards.title: Get the PC checked (burning smell)
cards.why: It smelled like burning on 2026-10-26 while the CPU was near 100%. Long runs could damage it or start a fire.
cards.how: Until it is checked, keep runs short.
steps: Check the thermal paste and the power supply
Run a short CPU test and watch the temperature
Tell Claude it is fine, so heavy runs can start

cards.title: Fix Ho Hey's start on the studio audio
cards.why: The beginning sync is crucial: bar 1 lands about 0.9 s late. The intro runs about 2% slower, and one steady tempo gives up bars 1-16. fix_start moves them, but its onset check rejects the move.
cards.how: `python tests/yt2gp5/fromlink.py "https://youtu.be/SuZytYa71lk" --again`
steps: Check bars 1-16 against the drum stem
Fix fix_start's acceptance check so a good move is kept
Rerun and confirm the start lands

cards.title: Sync ladder, stage 1: 10 of 12 songs PASS (guitar)
cards.why: The goal you set: simple songs synced perfectly every time, one track first. All 12 recordings are already downloaded.
cards.how: `python tests/yt2gp5/ladder.py --tracks guitar`
steps: Fix one FAIL, rerun only that song

cards.title: Plain docs so it runs by itself
cards.why: You stop using Claude on 2026-11-04. Everything has to run from one command with a plain guide.
cards.how: One page per job, each with its one command and what PASS and FAIL mean.
steps: Add a song from a link
Each page: its one command, and what PASS / FAIL means

cards.title: Sync ladder, stage 2: guitar + bass
cards.why: Two tracks must line up together. Bass shows tempo drift that guitar alone hides.
cards.how: `python tests/yt2gp5/ladder.py --tracks guitar,bass`
steps: Fix each FAIL, rerun only that song

cards.title: Sync ladder, stage 3: guitar + bass + drums
cards.why: Drums give the clearest beat. If all three line up, the whole song is right.
cards.how: `python tests/yt2gp5/ladder.py --tracks guitar,bass,drums`
steps: Fix each FAIL, rerun only that song

cards.title: Longer songs on the ladder
cards.why: After the short songs pass: longer songs with tempo changes and bridges.
cards.how: Downloads are needed, so do it at home.
steps: Pick 10 longer songs with official audio

cards.title: Battle Belongs: a band tempo that drifts
cards.why: One tempo can't fit a live-feel recording. One tempo per section is allowed only when the drift is proven.
cards.how: Prove the drift with the per-4-bar check, then let section_tempo take only those sections.
steps: Let section_tempo take only the drifting sections
